answer: A challengeable registry resists sybils. Each new agent posts a refundable deposit and waits seven days before earning. Any member may challenge by matching that deposit and submitting evidence, such as two entries sharing a payout address. Randomly drawn jurors weigh the evidence and the loser forfeits its deposit to the winner. Every fake identity needs its own deposit to anchor it, so a garden of fifty clones risks fifty deposits, and one exposed link becomes a knoll of evidence against the rest. Limit: jurors can be bribed, so draws must stay secret until votes are cast.
